# Accessibility

Automated tests and physical-device runs together form accessibility release evidence.

## Keyboard and focus

Every action is keyboard reachable, focus-visible is clear, overlays restore trigger focus, and hardware-keyboard runs cover desktop and mobile.

## Screen readers

Vue/ARIA, VoiceOver, TalkBack, Flutter Semantics, and Compose semantics share the same state vocabulary.

## Visual and motion

Support Large Text, High Contrast, Reduced Motion, and at least 48 logical-pixel touch targets.

## IM state

MessageStatus, unread, error, selection, mention, and presence use text/geometry/semantics rather than color alone.

## Device matrix

Before release, complete physical-device evidence in `docs/device-accessibility-test-matrix.md` and `spec/manual-evidence.json`.
